rv.q: Under the well-paced direction of Tyler Rosati, with music director Bethany Aiken leading a well-tuned seven-piece band, this is a solid “Annie.”
Greater Boston Stage Company proves this steadfast musical favorite never goes out of style.
So, between now and June 28 th , put on your best smiles and head over to Stoneham , MA. to see this heaping helping of this wonderful GBSC production of "ANNIE THE MUSICAL."
Annie is a disarmingly cheerful musical with very dark undertones.

cn.t: Critics find this production of the timeless musical charming and uplifting, with particular praise for young Livia Quist's performance as the eternally optimistic orphan who spreads hope during the Depression.
